title: Epics
description: Schema for docs/planning/epics.yaml — the SoT list of epics with verbatim Gherkin business scenarios.

cm_ticket.description: Optional change-management ticket id (e.g. CHG-12345, JIRA-7, CM-1). Required when the team_preset enforces require_ticket_reference: true (see templates/presets/enterprise/git-workflow.md). Inherited by tasks under this epic unless a task carries its own cm_ticket override.

slug.description: Optional explicit slug for the epic. Used by /002-implement to substitute {slug} in branch_name_pattern (e.g. epic/E-007-subscription-cancellation). When omitted, /002-implement derives the slug from `title` via kebab-case at branch-creation time. Author explicitly only when auto-derivation produces something unwieldy.

pr_url.description: URL of the epic-level merge/pull request opened by /006-merge. Appended by /006-merge after a successful gh/glab PR-create call. Idempotency anchor — /006-merge refuses to open a second PR when this field is present.
